**Issue #3549 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3549: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S11, the drills and Mindustrial suppliers
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the drills and the cards that hand you Mindustrial cards.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #39 | Mindustrial Cross-over |
| #52 | Airblast Drill |
| #53 | Laser Drill |
| #54 | Pneumatic Drill |
| #58 | Phase Conveyer |
| #71 | Mindustrial Contract |
| #166 | Mindustrial Revolution (the list's second #140) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E3 (#3543): Flexible.
- E4 (#3546): GIGA.
- S09 (#3547): the Minerals; and the six Stinkyscape Resources.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- "Minerals (that cost 0)" are the set's Mineral cards (#44 to #50) at cost (0). "Resources" are the six Stinkyscape Resources and the Warhero Token.
- #52 Airblast Drill: "Fill your hand" adds cards until the hand is full (`HAND_LIMIT`).
- #53 Laser Drill: GIGA once (the list says it twice on the Radiant face).
- #39 Mindustrial Cross-over: "Starpiece" means Starship Piece.
- #166 Mindustrial Revolution: renumbered from the second #140 (SP5).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(1) Mindustrial Cross-over, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #39**
**Discover** a random **Mindustrial Unit,** give it **Starpiece** & **Equip**
~~~
**Discover** a random **Radiant** **Mindustrial Unit,** give it **Starpiece** & **Equip,** it costs (1) less

**(4) Airblast Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #52**
**GIGA**
**Tribute 1**
**End of turn:** Fill your hand with random **Minerals** (that cost 0) and **Resources**
~~~
**GIGA**
**Tribute 1**
**End of turn:** Fill your hand with random **Radiant** **Minerals** (that cost 0) and **Radiant** **Resources**

**(4) Laser Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #53**
**GIGA**
**End of turn:** Add three random **Minerals** (that cost 0) or **Resources** to your hand
~~~
**GIGA**
**GIGA**
**End of turn:** Add three random **Radiant** **Minerals** (that cost 0) or **Radiant** **Resources** to your hand

**(2) Pneumatic Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #54**
**End of turn:** Add a random **Minerals** or **Resources** to your hand
~~~
**End of turn:** Add a random **Radiant** **Minerals** or **Radiant** **Resources** to your hand

**(1) Phase Conveyer, Unit, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #58**
**Flexible**
0/3
**Start of turn:** add a **Mineral** and **Resource** to your hand
~~~
**Flexible**
0/6
**Start of turn:** add a **Radiant** **Mineral** and a **Radiant** **Resource** to your hand

**(1) Mindustrial Contract, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #71**
Add 3 random **Mindustrial** cards to your hand
~~~
Add 3 random **Radiant Mindustrial** cards to your hand

**(2) Mindustrial Revolution, Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #140**
For the rest of the game at the start of your turn add a random **Mindustrial** card to your hand
~~~
For the rest of the game at the start of your turn add a random **Radiant Mindustrial** card to your hand, it costs (1) less
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3546, #3547

Part of #3534.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42889819466)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Build the seven S11 cards' scripts and tests in their own files, replacing the foundation's stubs: #39 Mindustrial Cross-over, #52 Airblast Drill, #53 Laser Drill, #54 Pneumatic Drill, #58 Phase Conveyer, #71 Mindustrial Contract, #166 Mindustrial Revolution. Each plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the issue's readings, every number a named constant or card param, every prompt answered by the random policy and the timeout.

Add the seven §8.12 rows, five ruling notes (R3549000–R3549004) with proving tests and `spec/pending/3549.md` paragraphs, and update the seven catalog `loc` values. Nothing else changes: no engine, AI, web, census, or other card work, and the set stays `Held`.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c071_mindustrial_contract.rs` | change | Replace stub: `cry` adding 3 random Mindustrial cards; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c166_mindustrial_revolution.rs` | change | Replace stub: rest-of-game start-of-turn adder; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c039_mindustrial_cross_over.rs` | change | Replace stub: Discover + grant Starpiece/Equip resume; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c054_pneumatic_drill.rs` | change | Replace stub: end-of-turn single Mineral-or-Resource; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c053_laser_drill.rs` | change | Replace stub: end-of-turn three Minerals-or-Resources; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c052_airblast_drill.rs` | change | Replace stub: Tribute 1, GIGA, end-of-turn fill; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c058_phase_conveyer.rs` | change | Replace stub: start-of-turn Mineral + Resource; tests |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | `loc` of the seven entries only, from `cargo jackioh catalog loc` |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | Seven §8.12 rows after the #160 Icarus row, before the `T-` rows |
| `spec/rulings/R3549000.md` | new | #39: pool, grant-in-hand, discount; `proven_in` its script file |
| `spec/rulings/R3549001.md` | new | Drill generation: pools, costs, per-slot roll, fill count |
| `spec/rulings/R3549002.md` | new | #58: printed-cost Mineral, no prompt |
| `spec/rulings/R3549003.md` | new | #71: held-set Mindustrial pool, repeats, discount floor |
| `spec/rulings/R3549004.md` | new | #166: owner-only rest-of-game adder, discount floor |

Governing spec: §2.4 (hand cap, burn), §5.1 (pools), §5.2 (Radiant), §6.1 (Equip, Starship Piece), §6.3 (Discover, Add to hand, Tribute), §10.5–§10.6 (cry, resume), R62/R458 (turn hooks, rest-of-game), R65/R74/R78 (costs), R1420 (held set), R1748003 (PRICE-fixed numbers), R1840002 (Resources), R1878003 (keywords rider).

## Steps

1. Re-read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` and the spec sections above. Copy patterns from `classic_plus/c058_fruit_basket.rs` (#71), `classic_plus/c052_jlockeeds_permanent_defense_contract.rs` (#166), `stinkyscape/c060_radi.rs` (Discover shape), `stinkyscape/c130_jlockeeds_starship_retrofitting_program.rs` (keywords rider), `stinkyscape/c039_the_narcor_project.rs` (unprinted-count consts, `end_of_turn`), and `meditative/c085_playtester.rs` (rng pick, `start_of_turn`).
2. Write `spec/pending/3549.md` with five paragraphs in `spec/pending/3546.md` style, and `spec/rulings/R3549000.md`–`R3549004.md` with front matter (`id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in` listing the script file), in `spec/rulings/R3546000.md` style.
3. #71: `fn contract(radiant: bool) -> Script` with `cry` returning `add_random_from_catalog` over `{ "set": SetName::StinkyscapePlus, "tags": [Tag::Mindustrial] }`, `count: param(ctx, "card")`, `radiant` on the Radiant face. R387 self-exclusion is automatic. No catalog change: `card: 3` exists.
4. #166: file-local `const REVOLUTION_CARDS: i32 = 1;`, `const DISCOUNT: i32 = 1;`, `const STEP: &str = "revolution";` (both PRICE-fixed, no params). `cry` returns `for_rest_of_game` with label `fill_params(def_of(Some(&*ctx.state), ID), face, numbers)` and `data: { cards, discount }`, copying the `carried()` helper from `classic_plus/c052`; `delayed` returns `add_random_from_catalog` over the S+ Mindustrial query with carried count, `radiant` and `costMod: -carried discount` on the Radiant face.
5. #39: `const PICKED: &str = "picked";`, `const DISCOUNT: i32 = 1;` (PRICE-fixed). `cry` returns `discover_from_catalog` over `{ "set": SetName::StinkyscapePlus, "type": CardType::Unit, "tags": [Tag::Mindustrial] }` with prompt `"Discover a Mindustrial Unit"` (count unset: three options). `resume` on `PICKED` reads `chosen_options`, then returns `add_random_from_catalog` over `{ "defId": [picked] }` with `count: 1`, `keywords: Some(vec![Keyword::StarshipPiece, Keyword::Equip])` built as a typed struct exactly like `c130`, plus `radiant` and `costMod: -DISCOUNT` on the Radiant face. (`AddToHandArgs` has no keywords field, so the single-card pool is the mechanism.)
6. #54: `const MINERAL_CHANCE: f64 = 0.5;`, `const FINDS: i32 = 1;`. `end_of_turn` hook: `if ctx.rng.chance(MINERAL_CHANCE)` return `add_random_from_catalog` over `{ "set": SetName::StinkyscapePlus, "tags": [Tag::Mineral] }` at printed cost, else `gain_resources` with `count: 1`. Radiant face sets `radiant: true` on both (Mineral still printed cost).
7. #53: `const DRILL_FINDS: i32 = 3;` plus the same flip; loop three slots, each an independent flip. Minerals take `costOverride: 0` (`"costOverride": 0` in `json_as`); Radiant face adds `radiant: true` to both verbs.
8. #52: `const TRIBUTE: i32 = 1;` (PRICE-fixed) in `static_flags: Some(StaticFlags { tribute: Some(TRIBUTE), ..Default::default() })`; GIGA needs no script (catalog keyword, E4 engine-owned). `end_of_turn` hook computes `room_in(&*ctx.state, ctx.controller, OffFieldZone::Hand)` and returns one flipped Mineral (`costOverride: 0`) or `gain_resources(1)` effect per slot, Radiant flags on the Radiant face.
9. #58: `start_of_turn` hook returning exactly two effects: `add_random_from_catalog` over the Mineral query at printed cost, and `gain_resources` with `count: 1`; `radiant: true` on both for the Radiant face. No prompt opens. Flexible is catalog data only (E3).
10. Append the seven §8.12 rows as one block after the #160 Icarus row in numeric order (39, 52, 53, 54, 58, 71, 166), each Engine cell describing the mechanism and citing its ruling and `Built by S11 (#3549)`.
11. Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc` on each of the seven files and write the seven `loc` values into `catalog.json`.
12. Run the checks in **Tests** and `cargo jackioh spec check`; fix honestly, never weaken a gate.

## Tests

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c039_mindustrial_cross_over.rs`: `r3549000_the_discover_offers_three_mindustrial_units_of_the_held_set` (three options, each a non-token S+ Mindustrial Unit; 60-seed sweep proves the pool is exactly the 35, never self); `r3549000_the_pick_reaches_the_hand_with_starpiece_and_equip` (`granted_keywords == [StarshipPiece, Equip]`, printed cost); radiant variant (Radiant, `cost_mod == -1`); `the_discount_floors_at_0` (seed-search a 0-cost offer among #110/#115/#120, assert `effective_cost` 0); `a_full_hand_burns_the_pick`; `the_random_policy_answers_the_discover` (`subsystems::choose_action` yields an `Answer`); `a_timeout_answers_the_discover`.
- `.../c071_mindustrial_contract.rs`: `r3549003_the_pool_is_the_held_set_s_mindustrial_cards_never_this_one` (every gain Mindustrial-tagged non-token, never the contract; expected pool computed with `crate::query::pool` has 69); `adds_3_random_mindustrial_cards`; radiant (`radiant`, `cost_mod == -1`); discount floor via a 0-cost gain; full-hand burn.
- `.../c166_mindustrial_revolution.rs`: `r3549004_a_rest_of_game_modifier_adds_one_mindustrial_before_each_owner_draw` (badge label equals the catalog text; graveyard after cast; delivery positioned before the turn's `Drawn`); `nothing_on_the_opponent_s_turns`; `a_board_wipe_does_not_end_it` (play `core-088` Twisting Nether as in the C+ #52 test); radiant; floor 0; burn; JSON round-trip replays identically.
- `.../c054_pneumatic_drill.rs`: `r3549001_the_mineral_pool_is_s_plus_44_to_50`; `adds_exactly_one_mineral_or_resource` (Mineral has no override and `cost_mod` 0, or `is_resource_card`); radiant variant (Radiant, Mineral still printed cost); nothing on the opponent's end of turn.
- `.../c053_laser_drill.rs`: `r3549001_end_of_turn_adds_three_minerals_or_resources` (exactly three; each a `costOverride`-0 Mineral or a Resource); radiant (all Radiant).
- `.../c052_airblast_drill.rs`: `tribute_1_is_required` (refused without, offered with); `giga_fills_four_zones` (play with `{"zone": 1, "tributes": [...]}`); `r3549001_end_of_turn_fills_the_hand` (hand equals `HAND_CAP`, each a cost-0 Mineral or Resource); radiant; full hand is a no-op; opponent's end adds nothing.
- `.../c058_phase_conveyer.rs`: `r3549002_start_of_turn_adds_one_mineral_and_one_resource` (Mineral at printed cost, no prompt open); nothing on the opponent's start; radiant variant.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c039_mindustrial_cross_over`, `c052_airblast_drill`, `c053_laser_drill`, `c054_pneumatic_drill`, `c058_phase_conveyer`, `c071_mindustrial_contract`, `c166_mindustrial_revolution`; then `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] All seven scripts play both faces with tests in-file; every number a const or param.
- [ ] Five ruling notes exist with proving tests and `spec/pending/3549.md` paragraphs; `spec check` passes.
- [ ] §8.12 rows added; seven catalog `loc` values updated; `catalog check` passes.
- [ ] Random policy and timeout answer #39's Discover in tests (the only prompt); no AI code needed since Discover is an existing prompt kind answered through `legal_actions`.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `fmt --check`, and `clippy -p jackioh-cards` pass; only the listed files changed; set still `Held`.

## Risks

- `gain_resources` with no pool rolls every def carrying `resource`: today the six Stinkyscape tokens, plus the Warhero Token once E5 (#3548) gives it a `resource` entry. Tests assert `is_resource_card`, never an id, so they pass before and after E5.
- R2201001 excludes Legendary/Mythic Resources in held games: same remedy, no id pins.
- #52 is the first Tribute+GIGA Field Spell in the catalog, but the play validator reads `static_flags.tribute` generically (R101) and R3546000 covers Tribute-freed GIGA anchors; the tribute and four-zone tests prove the combination.
- The AI answers #39's Discover through the same `legal_actions` machinery as the random policy; proving it further would need an `ai` dev-dependency, which rule 4 forbids. CI's fuzz and gate waves exercise these cards under all controllers.

## Open questions

None. Every reading in the issue is taken as written; each ruling above records where the spec was silent and the rejected alternative.
````
